description: Examine three JSON configuration files (config.json, database.json, api_settings.json) in the workspace that contain validation errors. Use VSCode's Problems panel (Ctrl+Shift+M) to identify all JSON syntax and validation errors. Create a markdown file named 'validation_report.md' in the workspace root directory (/home/ga/workspace/json_validation_task/) that documents all found errors. The report must include: (1) A summary section stating the total number of errors found, (2) For each error: the file name, approximate line number, a clear description of what is wrong, and optionally a suggested fix, (3) Use proper markdown formatting with headers and lists. Save the report file when complete.
